reply.text:
Stiffness after a long drive is worth taking seriously, and I can't tell from here whether it's something a doctor or physio should look at, especially if it's sharp, spreading down a leg, or not easing. Please get that checked if it doesn't settle or gets worse.

On the training side, I can build today's session around your back. Tell me what you're working with and what to avoid, and I'll shape it that way; I'll keep heavy deadlifts out of it. Until then, I'd skip anything loaded and hinged today and keep it light.
